# `mise tool-alias unset`

- **Usage:** `mise tool-alias unset <TOOL> [ALIAS]`
- **Aliases:** `rm`, `remove`, `delete`, `del`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/tool_alias/unset.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/tool_alias/unset.rs)

Remove a backend alias or a version alias from the global config

With only TOOL, removes the tool's backend alias. With TOOL and ALIAS,
removes that version alias. Edits the global config
(~/.config/mise/config.toml by default).

## Arguments
- **`<TOOL>`** — The tool to remove the alias from
- **`[ALIAS]`** — The version alias to remove; omit it to remove the backend alias

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Remove ripgrep's backend alias

```
mise tool-alias unset ripgrep
```

Remove node's project version alias

```
mise tool-alias unset node project
```
